title: Assistance Coordination Note: Longest Recomputed Patient Payment Plan Schedule by Household Screening
content:
For a **Patient Payment Plan** installment recomputed after added balances, the longest recomputed schedule follows the open application's screening. A financial assistance application of the patient is open when one of the patient's financial assistance cases in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) stands in submitted or pending documents status, a submitted case being taken first. The screening is the household federal poverty level (FPL) percentage on that application in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care).

**Rule.** The longest recomputed schedule is 60 installments for a household screened at or below 200 percent of the federal poverty level and 48 installments for one screened above 200 and at or below 400 percent, each only on tiers whose maximum term is shorter; otherwise it is the tier's maximum term.

| Tier | Tier maximum term | At or below 200% FPL | Above 200%, at or below 400% FPL | Otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 6 | 60 | 48 | 6 |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 12 | 60 | 48 | 12 |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 24 | 60 | 48 | 24 |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 36 | 60 | 48 | 36 |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 48 | 60 | 48 | 48 |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |

A household screened at exactly 200 percent falls in the first column; at exactly 400 percent in the second; at 400.1 percent, or with no open application, in the last.
